entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A world of shards that during the Conflux overlap and merge with one another.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A restrained, cultivated shard of Alara whose castle and army meet Esper's.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A restrained, cultivated shard of Alara with etherium filigree towers.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara of red-hot lava pools and volcanic crags.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara of dead terrain and necropolises.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara supplying red mana that seeps toward Bant.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: A time of extreme change in which the shards of Alara overlap and converge.

entities.name: Incursion Zones
entities.description: Areas where one shard of Alara intrudes upon another during the Conflux.

entities.name: Reliquary Tower
entities.description: A Bant tower that emerges through the terrain, intruding on a sea of Esper.

entities.name: Rupture Spire
entities.description: A sharp filigree tower of Esper breaking through the terrain of Grixis.

entities.name: Paragon of the Amesha
entities.description: A Bant advance scout who already uses foreign black and red mana seeping into Bant.

entities.name: Knight of the Reliquary
entities.description: A knight who can succeed at recovering the lost Reliquary Tower.

entities.name: Galanda Feudkiller
entities.description: An arbiter giant whose amphitheater is Ancient Amphitheater.

entities.name: Ancient Amphitheater
entities.description: The amphitheater of the arbiter giant Galanda Feudkiller.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane with artifact lands and the Great Furnace.

events.summary: During the Conflux, a Bant castle emerges through the terrain, intruding on a sea of Esper.
events.quote: which shows Bant intruding on one of the seas of Esper

events.summary: The borderland of Jund and Grixis becomes a messy place as dead terrain bursts through lava and crags pierce necropolises.
events.quote: The dead terrain of Grixis would burst up through Jund's red-hot pools of lava, while the volcanic crags would pierce through Grixis's necropolises.

events.summary: An Esper tower rises in the middle of a Bant field, and Bant olive trees are overtaken by etherium filigree.
events.quote: this time an elegant Esper tower coming up in the middle of a field in Bant

events.summary: An Esper filigree tower and Grixis terrain collide at Rupture Spire.
events.quote: This is the quintessential moment when two alien worlds interact.

events.summary: Bant begins to come into contact with black mana from Esper and red from Naya, and Paragon of the Amesha uses it.
events.quote: At the time of the Conflux, Bant has barely come in contact with black mana (from Esper) and red mana (from Naya)

relations.quote: Knight of the Reliquary can actually succeed at recovering this lost Tower

relations.note: It is the arbiter giant's amphitheater.
relations.quote: Ancient Amphitheater is the amphitheater of the arbiter giant, Galanda Feudkiller.
